subject: Course Assignment - $course_code ($semester $year)
body:
Dear $instructor_name,

You have been assigned to teach the following course in the university system.

=== Course Assignment Details ===

Course: $course_code - $course_name
Department: $department
Semester: $semester
Year: $year

=== Your Responsibilities ===

- Teach the scheduled sessions for this course
- Prepare course materials and assessments
- Maintain regular office hours for student consultation
- Submit grades according to the academic calendar
- Report any scheduling conflicts immediately

=== Resources Available ===

- Course materials: Available on the learning management system
- Teaching resources: contact teaching.support@$email_domain
- Technical support: contact it.support@$email_domain

=== Important Notes ===

- Please confirm receipt of this email
- Review the course syllabus and learning outcomes
- Contact your Head of Department if you have any concerns about this assignment

This assignment was recorded on $assigned_timestamp.

Welcome to the teaching team!

Best regards,
Academic Administration Team

variables.instructor_name: Full name of the assigned instructor
variables.assigned_timestamp: Timestamp when the assignment was recorded
